images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down three-quarter view of a hand-embroidered linen map of a 1941 Eastern European village lying on a dark walnut farmhouse table, lit by a single warm candle from the upper left with flickering amber falloff and deep vignette. The map is stitched in madder red, indigo and black thread: flax field with tiny blue flowers, an orchard of french-knot apple trees, a cobbled lane, a bell tower, a checkpoint with a striped barrier, a granary of grain sacks. Patrol routes are embroidered: a confirmed route in dense tight indigo stitches, an unconfirmed route in sparse loose stitches, a contradictory route broken with red cross-stitch X marks. Tin soldier figurines stand on the cloth, a steel needle and loose thread rest on the bell tower. Left side: four parchment portrait cards of villagers (weaver, carter, orchard widow, bell-ringer boy) each with a red trust cost and risk dots. Right side: a wooden thread spool whose red thread shows village trust at 44%. Korean UI text: "속삭임 지도", "신뢰 44%", "계획을 짠다". Warm, intimate, tactile folk-craft style, serif typography, film grain. Visual constraints: the checkpoint flag is a plain unmarked grey pennant; no real-world national flags, insignia or emblems anywhere.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same embroidered linen village map on a table, now at night: moonlight from the upper right washes the cloth in cold desaturated blue, candle gone, deep blue-black vignette. Real-time tactics in progress: brass map pins mark the squad — a gold-headed sniper pin in the orchard with a glowing circular hold timer and pale translucent sight cones reaching across the lane, a green pin hidden among grain sacks in the granary with a dotted concealment ring, a blue pin waiting in the flax field. Grey tin soldier patrol figurines move along the lane; one is ringed in red danger, the empty bell tower glows with a soft green dashed circle marking a guard shift window. A red alert card on the right reads a contradiction between two villagers; a reprisal cost table below it. Bottom: a timeline bar with a green shift-change window and a playhead. Korean UI text: "경보 0 / 0", "종루가 빈다", "갈린 말". Quiet tension, moonlit folk-craft realism, serif typography, subtle grain. Text constraints: the only date/place caption is "첫째 밤"; do not show any year, real or French-sounding place names, or personal names; the map is the same hand-embroidered linen cloth as the dusk screen, with visible stitches.
